services.name: Maha’ulepu Scenic Ocean, Mountain, Valley Ride
services.desc: 2 Hours Availability Tuesday-Friday 9:30am and 2:00pm (check in is 30 minutes before your ride starts!) About This scenic journey, offered twice daily, takes you through the historic Maha‘ulelpu coastline. You’ll experience a variety of scenery and terrain from coastal and mountain vistas to agricultural ranch land. View native plants and wildlife all while enjoying some of the most beautiful panoramic ocean, mountain and valley views on the south shore of Kauai What to wear and bring: Covered/Closed toe shoes Long Pants are recommended, 2 Hours • Ages 8+ • Your Bucket List Scenic Beach and Valley Ride!

services.desc: Your Wrangler, Jimmy Miranda is a 4th generation Paniolo (Hawaiian Cowboy). He born and raised on Kukaiou Ranch on the Island of Hawaii (Big Island). He holds many championship titles from Team Roping, Bull Riding, Saddle Bronc and Barrel Racing just to name a few. Our private excursions are the only rides that we offer where you can pick up the pace to a trot or a canter.. Here you will be an alongside the legendary Jimmy Miranda as he shares his experiences of growing up on the ranch and the rich history of the Paniolo Cowboy in Hawaii. This ride can be customized to fit a variety of your 2 hours •The Ultimate Private Experience with the Owner •trotting & cantering

services.name: Kauai Sunrise Private Custom Excursion
services.desc: Begin your day with the magic of dawn as the island awakens. Our exclusive Sunrise Ride takes you across breathtaking Kauai landscapes, where the first light paints the sky in vibrant colors and the island feels calm, peaceful, and alive. • Available most Saturdays – Please call for availability on other days. • A Personalized, intimate experience tailored to your Riding Experience • A signature Kauai adventure that blends natural beauty, tranquility, and connection with your horse. ✨ This is not just a horseback ride—it’s an unforgettable moment to greet the sun in one of the most beautiful 2 Hours • Custom tailored to your ability • only ride allowing trotting & Canter

services.name: Private Custom Excursion
services.desc: Come experience the Magnificent Mahaulepu Coastline! Your guide will Custom tailor this ride to your ability • The Custom Private Excursions are the only rides that we are able to pick up the pace to a trot and canter! Truly a memorable ride, whether you are a first time rider, or an accomplished equestrian. Sundresses, flapping material, Backpacks, ponchos and rain gear are NOT ALLOWED on tours for your Safety We can 1.5 Hours • Custom tailored to your ability • Trotting & Cantering allowed

services.name: Team Rope / Breakaway in Paradise
services.desc: This excursion is perfect for the vacationing experienced Roper who needs a quick Roping fix! Come hang out with the owner & Ohana! Jimmy Miranda is a 4th generation Paniolo, (Hawaiian Cowboy). Jimmy was born and raised on Kukaiau Ranch wich was established in 1885 on the Island of Hawaii (Big Island). He holds many championship titles from Team Roping, Bull Riding, Saddle Bronc and Barrel Racing just to name a few. This excursion includes one hour practice session in our rodeo arena on live steers and the hot heels. Plan on being at the ranch for at least two hours. We will talk story, rope 2hrs • For the Experienced Roper • Custom tailored to your ability
